root_cause: Original due-only source retry selector explicitly excluded all original action keys dated on the current Amsterdam day. Production had five original 2026-11-15 first-party research actions already due at 18:05 UTC, but #116 original research health at 18:41 UTC retried only one older date action; current daily new-domain cap had already been consumed and did not select those due IDs. This was misread as a cron that ran successfully while its due business work stayed stalled.
owner: Original #116 research worker and original-agent:commercial; #138 identity consumer, agent-reliability and data-quality verify
corrective_action: Change existing original due-only action predicate to admit already-due original current Amsterdam-day IDs as well as historical ones, without creating new actions or exceeding two retries per worker invocation. Keep source failure classification, backoff, original idempotent key, read-only public official page checks and separate consumer ACK.
prevention_rule: An original research retry queue must be drained by explicit due time and original action identity, not excluded by a day partition that belongs only to new-action allocation. Green cron is insufficient; fail closed if due backlog remains unchanged across natural executions.
